option_relations.rationale: Borderline lepromatous leprosy is a form of leprosy, which is a distinct infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium leprae, unrelated to Lupus erythematosus.
Lupus panniculitis is a specific subtype of lupus erythematosus, characterized by inflammation of the subcutaneous fat.
Lepromatous leprosy is a form of leprosy, which is a distinct infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium leprae, unrelated to Lupus erythematosus.
Histoid leprosy is a rare variant of lepromatous leprosy, which is a distinct infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium leprae, unrelated to Lupus erythematosus.
